description: Estimates display ad revenue for a website or blog from monthly pageviews and page RPM, or from ad impressions per page, CPM and fill rate.

ads_per_page.description: Ad units per page, used with cpm.

cpm.description: Earnings per 1,000 ad impressions, in currency units.

currency.description: ISO currency code for display, for example INR, USD or AED. Defaults to INR.

page_rpm.description: Earnings per 1,000 pageviews (from AdSense reports), in currency units. Use this or cpm.

name: website_ad_revenue
title: Website ad revenue (AdSense) calculator
